description: Unit tests for the HealthcheckService component, testing ping mechanisms, server removal, and acknowledgment handling within a server management context.

classes.name: HealthcheckServiceTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing the HealthcheckService, providing setup, utility methods, and test cases.

methods.name: timerWillBeCreated
methods.description: Sets expectations for timer creation and activation, mocking timer behavior.

methods.name: pingWillBeSent
methods.description: Sets expectation for sending a ping and captures the ping ID.

methods.name: errorIndicationWillBeSent
methods.description: Sets expectation for indicating a server error state.

methods.name: createSut
methods.description: Creates the System Under Test (SUT) with optional custom healthcheck interval.

methods.name: triggerPingTimeout
methods.description: Simulates the timer callback to trigger a ping timeout.

methods.name: triggerOnPingSent
methods.description: Simulates the event of a ping being sent.

methods.name: triggerOnServerRemoved
methods.description: Simulates the event of server removal.

methods.name: triggerOnAckReceived
methods.description: Simulates receiving an acknowledgment for a ping.
